title: [DOC-11] O365 device-key registration request diverges from spec §2.5.4 and embeds `sig` in the bod
description: Review finding DOC-11: O365 device-key registration request diverges from spec §2.5.4 and embeds `sig` in the body (lens DOC). Location: profiles/o365-employer-did.md:532-547, :555; spec/02-identity.md:327-332; spec/13-encoding.md:51. Fix: As proposed. The spec body uses `deviceEd25519PublicKey`, `deviceX25519PublicKey` and `idpToken` (02-identity.md:327-332). The profile uses `devicePublicKey`, omits X25519, carries the token as a Bearer header, and puts `sig` inside the body. Also align the token placement, or state that the Bearer header substitutes for `idpToken`. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
